venus.x: First planetary atmosphere probed (Venera 4) and first robotic surface landing on another world (Venera 7 in 1970).

trappist-1-e.x: Prime Earth-sized habitable-zone target in the TRAPPIST-1 system subjected to exhaustive atmospheric reconnaissance by JWST NIRSpec and MIRI.

teegarden-s-star-d.x: Earth-mass exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of an ultra-cool red dwarf 12.5 light-years from Earth, confirmed in 2024.
